budget.rationale: The reconciled 6-line-item family budget is $13,200–$18,890 (sum tolerance ±$150); it is a planning band, not a live quote.

weather.rationale: ERA5 route history supports a real alpine-to-Mediterranean spread: cool/wet mountain exposure and hot Sardinia afternoons. That recurring management matches Weather 4/5.

fireRisk.rationale: Moderate is the safety rating (3/5), corresponding to a 5–10% planning chance of material wildfire disruption during the exact trip window. Sardinia formally designates June 1–October 31 as high fire danger. In 2026 the island recorded roughly 670 June fires before the full July aerial deployment, making this a recurring planning issue even when most ignitions remain small.

swim.rationale: OISST history supports roughly 74–77°F Sardinia water in early July; swimming is frequent on the island leg but absent from most of the Venice/Dolomites half, supporting 3/5.

variety.rationale: Four bases explicitly deliver Venice culture, assisted alpine hiking, and two Sardinia water/coast modes; Variety 5/5 is directly supported.

ease.rationale: Four bases, three moves, two rental-car systems, and a separate VCE–OLB flight create moderate deterministic load; Ease 3/5 is supported.

food.rationale: Current first-party store pages independently document grocery/plain-food fallback coverage in Venice, San Vito di Cadore, Cannigione, and Cala Gonone. That supports Food 4/5; store hours and stock still need a pre-trip recheck.

risk.rationale: Volotea currently sells nonstop VCE–OLB and the 2026 lift season covers the analogous dates, but neither the July 2027 flight nor lift calendar is published. Current-proxy is the high-confidence conclusion.

nights.rationale: 13 hotel nights derives a 5/5 score from the canonical nights rubric.

novelty.rationale: Novelty is derived from the documented visited-place overlap list; this route scores 5/5 under that rubric.

pto.rationale: 9 PTO days derives a 2/5 slider score and has zero default weight.
